  I want to receive discounts on my cart when I buy enough products from a promoted taxon
  So that I can pay less for eligible purchases

  Background:
    Given the store operates on a single channel
    And the store has a taxon "Summer Collection"
    And the store has a taxon "Winter Collection"
    And the store has a product "Beach T-shirt" in the "Summer Collection" taxon
    And the store has a product "Sunglasses" in the "Summer Collection" taxon
    And the store has a product "Winter Hat" in the "Winter Collection" taxon
    And the product "Beach T-shirt" costs $30.00
    And the product "Sunglasses" costs $20.00
    And the product "Winter Hat" costs $25.00

  @promotion @cart_discount
  Scenario: Apply a fixed discount when the cart contains enough products from the promoted taxon
    Given there is a promotion "Summer taxon discount"
    And the promotion "Summer taxon discount" gives a fixed discount of $15.00
    And the promotion "Summer taxon discount" targets the "Summer Collection" taxon
    And the promotion "Summer taxon discount" requires a minimum eligible product total of $50.00
    And I have product "Beach T-shirt" in my cart with quantity 1
    And I have product "Sunglasses" in my cart with quantity 1
    When I recalculate my cart
    Then I should see a discount of $15.00 applied to my order total
    And the order total should be reduced by $15.00

  @promotion @cart_discount
  Scenario: Do not apply a discount when the cart contains products from a different taxon
    Given there is a promotion "Summer taxon discount"
    And the promotion "Summer taxon discount" gives a fixed discount of $15.00
    And the promotion "Summer taxon discount" targets the "Summer Collection" taxon
    And the promotion "Summer taxon discount" requires a minimum eligible product total of $50.00
    And I have product "Winter Hat" in my cart with quantity 2
    When I recalculate my cart
    Then I should not see any discount applied to my order total
    And the order total should remain unchanged

  @promotion @cart_discount
  Scenario: Do not apply a discount when the promoted taxon total does not meet the minimum threshold
    Given there is a promotion "Summer taxon discount"
    And the promotion "Summer taxon discount" gives a fixed discount of $15.00
    And the promotion "Summer taxon discount" targets the "Summer Collection" taxon
    And the promotion "Summer taxon discount" requires a minimum eligible product total of $50.00
    And I have product "Beach T-shirt" in my cart with quantity 1
    When I recalculate my cart
    Then I should not see any discount applied to my order total
    And the order total should remain unchanged

  @promotion @cart_discount
  Scenario: Apply the discount once when multiple quantities meet the minimum threshold
    Given there is a promotion "Summer taxon discount"
    And the promotion "Summer taxon discount" gives a fixed discount of $15.00
    And the promotion "Summer taxon discount" targets the "Summer Collection" taxon
    And the promotion "Summer taxon discount" requires a minimum eligible product total of $50.00
    And I have product "Beach T-shirt" in my cart with quantity 2
    When I recalculate my cart
    Then I should see a discount of $15.00 applied to my order total
    And the promotion "Summer taxon discount" should be applied once

  @promotion @cart_discount
  Scenario: Apply multiple discounts when different promotions target different taxons
    Given there is a promotion "Summer taxon discount"
    And the promotion "Summer taxon discount" gives a fixed discount of $15.00
    And the promotion "Summer taxon discount" targets the "Summer Collection" taxon
    And the promotion "Summer taxon discount" requires a minimum eligible product total of $50.00
    And there is a promotion "Winter taxon discount"
    And the promotion "Winter taxon discount" gives a fixed discount of $10.00
    And the promotion "Winter taxon discount" targets the "Winter Collection" taxon
    And the promotion "Winter taxon discount" requires a minimum eligible product total of $25.00
    And I have product "Beach T-shirt" in my cart with quantity 1
    And I have product "Sunglasses" in my cart with quantity 1
    And I have product "Winter Hat" in my cart with quantity 1
    When I recalculate my cart
    Then I should see a discount of $15.00 applied for the "Summer taxon discount"
    And I should see a discount of $10.00 applied for the "Winter taxon discount"

    As an Administrator
    I want to view an order summary showing item prices with all applicable promotion discounts
    So that I can understand how product-level and order-level promotions affect each order item’s final price

    Background:
        Given the store operates on a single channel
        And the store has a product "PHP T-Shirt" priced at "$60.00"
        And the store has a product "Symfony Mug" priced at "$40.00"
        And the store has a product promotion "PHP T-Shirt discount" for product "PHP T-Shirt" with a discount of "$20.00" per unit
        And the store has an order promotion "Order discount" with a discount of "$10.00" applied to the order
        And there is an order containing 2 units of "PHP T-Shirt" and 1 unit of "Symfony Mug"
        And the order promotion is applied to the order
        And the product promotion is applied to the "PHP T-Shirt" items

    @ui
    Scenario: Administrator views an order summary with original prices, discounted prices, and allocated discounts
        Given I am logged in as an administrator
        When I view the summary of the order
        Then I should see that the order summary displays the original unit price for "PHP T-Shirt" as "$60.00"
        And I should see that the order summary displays the discounted unit price for "PHP T-Shirt" as "$36.66"
        And I should see that the order summary displays the quantity for "PHP T-Shirt" as "2"
        And I should see that the order summary displays the item discount for "PHP T-Shirt" as "-$20.00"
        And I should see that the order summary displays the allocated order discount for "PHP T-Shirt" as "-$3.34"
        And I should see that the order summary displays the subtotal for "PHP T-Shirt" as "$73.33"

        And I should see that the order summary displays the original unit price for "Symfony Mug" as "$40.00"
        And I should see that the order summary displays the discounted unit price for "Symfony Mug" as "$36.67"
        And I should see that the order summary displays the quantity for "Symfony Mug" as "1"
        And I should see that the order summary displays the item discount for "Symfony Mug" as "$0.00"
        And I should see that the order summary displays the allocated order discount for "Symfony Mug" as "-$3.33"
        And I should see that the order summary displays the subtotal for "Symfony Mug" as "$36.67"

    Scenario: Order summary reflects product-specific promotions in the discounted unit price and item discount
        Given I am logged in as an administrator
        When I view the summary of the order
        Then the "PHP T-Shirt" line item should show the product promotion in the discounted unit price
        And the "PHP T-Shirt" line item should show the product promotion in the item discount
        And the "Symfony Mug" line item should not show any item-level discount

    Scenario: Order summary allocates order-wide promotions proportionally across order items
        Given I am logged in as an administrator
        When I view the summary of the order
        Then the order-level discount should be distributed proportionally across the order items
        And the "PHP T-Shirt" line item should receive an allocated order discount of "-$3.34"
        And the "Symfony Mug" line item should receive an allocated order discount of "-$3.33"
        And the sum of allocated order discounts should equal the total order-level discount
